verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Greenhouse has native scorecards with defined questions: its Notetaker maps AI-generated interview notes onto those scorecard questions. That confirms structured scorecards exist in the interview workflow, but the pack only mentions them in passing, inside AI note-taking marketing. missing for 10: documentation of defined attributes per interview stage, focused rubrics or attribute assignment per interviewer, rating scales, cross-candidate comparison of scorecard results, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a hiring manager, interviews are scored on structured scorecards — defined attributes per stage, focused rubrics per interviewer, comparable across candidates

citations.quote: Greenhouse Notetaker automatically records and transcribes interviews, then instantly maps AI-generated notes directly to scorecard questions for clear feedback
AI summaries are mapped to scorecard questions, reducing time to submission and dramatically increasing completion.
